about_the_game:
The Furry Protocol is a game in which you have to escape from an underground Soviet scientific research complex in the Siberian forests. There has been an accident at the complex, it is badly destroyed and filled with terrifying monsters that you must fight back to survive. Your main enemy on the way to salvation is a virus that is rapidly progressing, destroying your body and enslaving your mind. Find out the full story of the events that led to the incident at the complex, destroy the virus in your body and get out of the complex alive.

Horror elements

  • The game will immerse you in an atmosphere of horror. During the passage, you will find yourself in a variety of rooms that were filled with life not so long ago and now tell the stories of the collapse of the underground complex, the death of its workers and how it was overrun by monsters.

    Monster design. The monsters in the game are former humans, the virus caused them to mutate by changing their bodies. Some monsters have severely deformed limbs, an open chest, the absence of some organs or the presence of additional ones.

Mature content

The game features murder scenes, grievous bodily harm, regular violent acts, and blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX580 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX6600 or NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Survive and escape from the scientific research complex in the Siberian forests and uncover the secrets of the corporation that built this complex.
